candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 because its downstream call to order POST /v1/orders returns HTTP 500; traces and logs show the 500 originating at the order service, propagating as 502 at the gateway.
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause within order service (db-pool, redis, config) not established; only the 500 propagation is observed.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s correlate with order service returning 500 on POST /v1/orders across traces, logs, and metrics. The gateway is a victim of the downstream 500; the specific internal fault in order is not yet evidenced, so only the http-500 propagation is bounded.
missing_evidence: Order service logs/traces for the failing /v1/orders requests to identify the internal 500 cause
Order service dependency metrics (postgresql, payment, inventory) to rule out db-pool-exhaustion or downstream-latency
